facts: Parties: Merrion Engineering Ltd (Buyer), Northgate Software Ltd (Seller); the Company is Larkspur Engineering Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 28 February 2027; Closing is scheduled for 1 June 2027 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 15.1: this Agreement is governed by English law and the courts of England have exclusive jurisdiction.

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 24 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 48 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $5,000,000.

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $950,000 (0.5% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.
Clause 12: this escrow agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York and disputes shall be referred to arbitration in New York.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $4,090,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $188,180,000.
